title: ACL Revoke 0.2 — payload
description: Remove a subject's AclEntry 0.2, or narrow its act scope. What is revoked is stated explicitly in `revocation` — there is no form in which the absence of a member selects full removal. Narrowing of other axes (capabilities, approvable capabilities, approve scope, keys) is carried by acl/update/0.2 as a privilege reduction. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

subject.description: VID of the subject whose entry is removed or narrowed.

revocation.description: What is revoked: the whole entry, or act scope down to a stated narrower one.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale for the revocation.

Revocation.title: Revocation
Revocation.description: Exactly one of: `{"kind": "entry"}` — remove the entry entirely; `{"kind": "act", "act": AuthorityScope}` — replace the entry's act scope with the stated, strictly narrower one, keeping the entry.

NarrowAct.title: NarrowAct
NarrowAct.description: Narrow the entry's act scope to `act`, which MUST be strictly narrower than the stored act scope (a subset of its contexts, or `none`). The entry, and every other axis of it, remains.

act.description: The resulting act scope, in the explicit form. Stating the result rather than a list of contexts to remove means the producer and the maintainer cannot disagree about what remains.

Response.title: ACL Revoke 0.2 — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/revoke/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/revoke/0.2#response.

entry.description: null for a removal; the resulting AclEntry for an act-scope narrowing.
